key_insight: A dependency-aware greedy scheduler can exploit fine-grained parallelism in multi-core quantum circuits to cut execution makespan beyond simple layer-by-layer scheduling.
engineering_relevance: For quantum hardware designers and compiler engineers, better scheduling directly improves core utilization and can hide communication latency, making multi-core NISQ systems more practical.
method: Start with a layered baseline where gates in the same layer run in parallel and layers run sequentially.
Use a greedy policy that schedules each gate as soon as its dependencies and required resources are ready.
Exploit cross-core parallelism to overlap computation and communication more effectively.
evidence_signal: On real benchmarks, the greedy scheduler achieved an average 40% reduction in makespan and improved core utilization.
watch_item: The approach likely depends on accurate dependency tracking and resource/communication modeling, so real hardware overheads could affect gains.
paper_title: Dependency-Aware Circuit Scheduling for Multi-Core Quantum Systems to Minimize Makespan
